unit.why: A biographical narrative: R. Shlomo of Kshanov goes to Nikolsburg at his wife's urging, debates with the Moravian rabbis for R. Shmelke, meets the Seer of Lublin there, and later travels on to Lizhensk.
unit.boundary_note: continues the biography of the Kshanov tzaddik begun in the previous division (wife, goldsmith episode)

stories.start_quote: בעת ההוא נשמע כי הגאון הק׳
stories.end_quote: ובכל עת התעכב שם כמה חדשים
stories.summary_en: At his wife's urging, the young R. Shlomo of Kshanov studies two years with R. Shmelke in Nikolsburg and debates the Moravian rabbis who doubted R. Shmelke's learning; he fails to test the reticent, devout Seer of Lublin, is told on leaving to study Talmud and Tosafot (later Sha'arei Orah) while the Seer is told Etz Hayyim; back home his wife wakes him nightly to study and then sends him to the rabbi of Lizhensk.
